mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE rose from 4.9% in Feb to 5.1% in Mar 2008
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST fell to 1065k in Feb 2008, RSAFS fell to 381.4B in Mar 2008
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle contraction, a decline in industrial production below 105 for two consecutive months signals a manufacturing slowdown that precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO fell to 111.9 in Feb 2008 (revised to 101.8)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 105 in a late-cycle contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales growth over the past 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI inflation rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by >0.2pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both employment growth and the unemployment rate (indicating a shrinking labor force) signal an economic contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS grew by 137.8k in Mar 2008, UNRATE rose to 5.1%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime, a decline in industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months signals a severe supply shock that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 100 in a manufacturing slowdown regime.
